blocks.tamil_translation: If he becomes your imam, then he is your amir,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- It is known from some other narrations that Rasulullah ﷺ at times appointed someone as amir because of a particular quality, even though his companion was better than him; this has been mentioned in the explanation of Hadith No. 156.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ عَبَدَ اللهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي لَا يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً فَأَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتي الزَّكَاةَ وَسَمِعَ وَأَطَاعَ فَإِنَّ اللهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي يُدْخِلُهُ مِنْ أَيِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ شَاءَ وَلَهَا ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابٍ وَمَنْ عَبَدَ اللهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي لَا يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً وَأَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَي الزَّكَاةَ وَسَمِعَ وَعَصَي فَإِنَّ اللهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي مِنْ أَمْرِهِ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ رَحِمَهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني ورجال احمد ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:٥ /٣٨٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever worshipped Allah Ta'ala without associating anyone with Him, established Salah, gave Zakat, and listened to the amir's word and obeyed him, Allah Ta'ala will admit him into Jannah through whichever of the gates of Jannah he wishes. Jannah has eight gates. And whoever worshipped Allah without associating anyone with Allah Ta'ala, established Salah, gave Zakat, and also listened to the amir's word, (but) did not obey him, his matter will be in the hands of Allah Ta'ala. If He wishes He may show mercy to him, or if He wishes He may punish him,” Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
